item.text: {"analysis":"The trial crashed with exit status 1 after consuming 40.52 allocated GPU-seconds. No validation score was returned, so improvement over parent HR@10=0.4313 or SASRec=0.505 cannot be assessed. The supplied traceback only reports the worker's subprocess failure; it does not expose the underlying training exception, so the cause is undetermined.","code_summary":"AttentiveSimilarity adds learned positional embeddings and two pre-normalized causal Transformer blocks (96 dimensions, two heads, 192-dimensional feed-forward layers, dropout 0.1). A zero-initialized tanh scalar gate blends encoded history into the original embeddings, preserving initial direct-similarity scores. Candidate-conditioned attention, recency bias, square-root normalization, sampling, loss, optimizer, and four-category routing remain intact. Padding-safe causal masks, strict checkpoint loading, predictor consistency checks, and architecture checks are included. Checkpoints are selected by validation HR@10 with NDCG@10 breaking ties."}
